title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Ek Rishta: The Bond Of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Mission Raniganj : The Great Bharat Rescue
desc: Jaswant Singh Gill, a mining engineer, bravely leads a rescue mission to save 65 miners stuck inside a flooded coal mine, risking everything for their lives and safety.

title: Aranmanai 4
desc: A man investigates his sister's suspicious death, uncovering dark secrets that spiral into chaos and terror as he learns far more than he ever expected.

title: Sitaare Zameen Par
desc: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train Neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Bairaag
desc: Bhola, a loyal servant, travels to Bombay to track down his master's runaway granddaughter's groom, but an unexpected mystery transforms his destiny and alters his very personality.

title: Humjoli
desc: Gopaldas marries heiress Roopa to get rich. His greed spirals out of control when he plots her murder to inherit her wealth.

title: Muqabala
desc: Two feared gangsters declare a truce and strike up an unlikely friendship, but their hard-won peace shatters when both fall for the same woman and refuse to let love go.

title: Saathi
desc: Suraj and Amar witness their father's murder. Later, Suraj embraces crime while Amar resists, leading to conflict between brothers torn apart by choices, loyalty, and vengeance.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Khushi
desc: Khushi and Karan share a fiery love-hate bond, but while playing cupid for their friends, they unexpectedly grow close and end up falling in love with each other.
